prompt:
Extract every policy commitment stated in the text below.

Rules:
- One commitment per line.
- Write each as a verb phrase: an action followed by its object. For example: "raise the income tax threshold" or "build 300000 new homes".
- State each commitment at the level of a distinct policy action, not its implementation details. Do not subdivide a single commitment into steps.
- Include every commitment. Do not select, rank, prioritise, or judge importance.
- Use the text's own terms for policy objects. Do not substitute synonyms.
- Do not number the lines. No bullets, headings, preamble, or commentary.
- If the text states no policy commitments, output the single word NONE.

<text>
Stronger Economy, Fairer Society: Opportunity for Everyone

Liberal Democrats set out a five‑year plan for an open, outward‑looking, greener and more equal UK that finishes balancing the books fairly while investing in people, places and the planet.

Responsible finances and productive investment
- Balance the structural current budget by 2017/18 with a fair mix of tax and savings; debt falls year on year thereafter.
- No rises in the main rates of Income Tax, NI, VAT or Corporation Tax; clamp down on avoidance and a levy on high‑value property.
- New fiscal rules allow borrowing for growth‑boosting infrastructure, housing and energy efficiency.

Prosperity for all: a high‑skill, low‑carbon economy
- Double economy‑wide innovation, expand Catapults and the Green Investment Bank; back advanced manufacturing, digital, science and creative industries.
- Reform banking to boost competition and SME finance; support alternative finance and community banking.
- Modern transport: HS2 as part of a UK‑wide high‑speed network, rail electrification, freight shift to rail, city light rail, and clean air plans with Low Emission Zones.

Green Britain Guarantee: five green laws
- Nature Act, Zero Carbon Britain Act (net‑zero by 2050; end unabated coal by 2025; 60% renewables by 2030), Green Transport Act (ultra‑low emission vehicles), Resource Efficiency and Zero Waste Act (70% recycling), Green Buildings Act (Band C homes, council tax incentives).
- Protect habitats on land and sea; plant a tree for every child.

Real help for family finances
- Raise the Personal Allowance to at least £12,500; consider aligning the NI threshold.
- 20 hours free childcare for 2–4s and from nine months for working parents, tax‑free childcare and 85% childcare support in Universal Credit.
- Expand Shared Parental Leave; Living Wage in central government; fairer sanctions; reform disability assessments; £250 annual Carer’s Bonus.
- Pensions triple lock in law; auto‑enrolment completed; pension freedoms protected.

Opportunity society: world‑class education
- Protect funding from nursery to 19; strengthen the Pupil Premium.
- Qualified teachers in every class; improve early years quality; aim to end child illiteracy and innumeracy by 2025; STEM focus and a “curriculum for life”.
- Double businesses hiring apprentices; expand Higher Apprenticeships; widen university access and transparency; 16–21 bus discount.

Health and care with equality for mental health
- At least £8bn more a year for the NHS in England by 2020; pooled health and care budgets locally by 2018.
- Parity for mental health with waiting‑time standards; expand talking therapies; transform children’s and perinatal mental health.
- Better GP access; fairer social care with a care cost cap; improve care workforce pay and standards.

Homes people can afford
- Build 300,000 homes a year including new Garden Cities; unlock public land; Housing Investment Bank.
- New Rent to Own and shared ownership; protect private renters with longer tenancies, licensing and fair fees.
- Insulate 4m homes by 2020 with council tax incentives; minimum Band C for low‑income and rented homes by 2027.

Freedom, rights and safer communities
- Protect the Human Rights Act; a Digital Bill of Rights; a second Freedoms Act; proportionate, targeted surveillance only.
- Evidence‑led justice: restorative approaches, specialist drug courts, presumption against short sentences; modern policing focused on prevention.
- Smarter, fairer immigration: full entry/exit checks, efficient asylum, welcome high‑skill migrants and students; reinstate post‑study STEM visas.

Power to people and places
- Home Rule within a federal UK: implement Smith for Scotland; Silk for Wales; sustain Northern Ireland institutions.
- Devolution on Demand across England; votes at 16; Single Transferable Vote for Westminster and local elections; reform the Lords; curb big money in politics.

Britain in the world
- Lead in a reformed EU; hold an In/Out referendum only with future sovereignty‑shifting treaty change; back fair trade and tax transparency.
- Maintain 0.7% aid; drive a global climate deal; uphold international law and human rights.
- Defence built on a Single Security Budget, NATO cooperation, strong cyber capabilities, and a reduced‑posture nuclear deterrent.
